name: cmd_faces_index
description: Index Faces (command `faces.index`). Params: {budgetMs?: 200, ids?: [photo ids to do first]} → {embedded, photosDone, pendingPhotos, indexedFaces, ms} — embed the faces in the library with the chosen recognition model, as many photos as fit in the time (at least one); call again until `pendingPhotos` is 0. `budgetMs: 0` only reports.
